basis.storeys: 12 upper storeys retained from the existing facade rhythm; not independently measured this round
basis.thicknessStatus: Authored structural estimate, not a surveyed or engineering-verified measurement.
basis.placement: Each slab occupies the bottom 0.22 m of an existing solid spandrel band and follows the tower footprint. The lowest starts above the open lobby at local 3.7 m. No ground floor fill, partitions, stairs, or new rooms.

cpuSunlightEvidence.method: Selected two tower models; visible meshes and colliders temporarily DoubleSide for conservative CPU rays. Sample x=-2355..-2270, z=630..725 at 2 m intervals, eye buElevation(x,z)+0.03, normalized BOSTON_DAYLIGHT direction, far=150. Count a deep leak only if first visible hit is glass, no shadow-casting geometry intersects, and collision entry/exit span >=10 m.
